children.value: Koine does not have Accessibility access, so clients cannot list or focus windows. Koine is the application that needs it, not its clients: switch Koine on in System Settings, under Privacy & Security, Accessibility. No restart is needed.
Koine never shows a credential again. If one is lost, revoke its grant and create another.

Reads the special locations that macOS names for Koine's own account, such as the home, Documents and Applications folders. Lists the applications that Spotlight has indexed on this Mac's disks, on mounted network volumes and in a remote home folder, with each one's name, bundle identifier and location. It reads no file contents and lists no folder. A returned location gives no access to it. Launching or opening a listed application still needs workspace:control and desktop:control.

Launches or reactivates any application registered on this Mac, not only configured shortcuts, and opens documents, folders and web addresses in their default application or a named one. Koine accepts no program, arguments, environment or shell command, but that is not a sandbox: the application that receives a document decides what happens, so a handler can run a script or follow a location document to another address or file. Launching, opening and revealing also need desktop:control, because activation is an allowed effect; neither capability works without the other.
Koine is not registered to start at login. Clients find the service unavailable until you open Koine.
Serving koine-desktop/1 at http://127.0.0.1:49152/graphql. Closing this window leaves it running.
